# Median of complete successful rest shards in Build and Test runs 38004713400

# The latter run failed its separate advisory Benchmarks check; both rest
# shards passed with complete, uncached reports in each run.
# Package elapsed times overlap because go test runs packages concurrently;
# these are scheduling weights, not predicted wall-clock durations.
# Weights move whole packages between the two existing required checks and
# start the heavier binaries first within each check. They cannot change
# internal/api's separate contiguous, order-preserving test slices.
# The checked-out go list supplies coverage, including new/unmeasured packages.
# Stale entries cannot add, omit or duplicate a package. DEFAULT_WEIGHT is
# the mean of measured test packages below 20 seconds in those same runs.
# Refresh from complete passing rest-shard logs when imbalance/tails return.
